titles.romaji: Toromitsu Musume no Hitou Service: Torottoro Churu Churu Gohoushi Sasete Kudasai
titles.english: Melting Juice Lolis' Spa Services: Let us do Slurp-Slurp-Melting Care!
titles.native: トロみつ娘の秘湯サービス ～とろッとろちゅるちゅるご奉仕させてください～

description:
Based on the CG collection by Churu Bitch Churu Churu (ちゅるびっちちゅるちゅる).

On a sunny holiday he took a drive to a certain rural village and awaiting him in an open-air bath were, unexpectedly, three little loli girls all in naughty outfits.

The three introduce themselves, and the service begins...

(Source: DLsite English, edited)
